CustomField.description: QCC: Arrival Delay in Hrs and MIN
CustomField.formula: IF (TechArrivalDelayDuration__c > 0, TEXT( FLOOR( 24 * TechArrivalDelayDuration__c)) & " Hrs " & TEXT( ROUND(60 * (ROUND( 24 * (TechArrivalDelayDuration__c - FLOOR(TechArrivalDelayDuration__c) ),8) - FLOOR( ROUND( 24 * (TechArrivalDelayDuration__c - FLOOR(TechArrivalDelayDuration__c) ),8)) ),0)) & " Mins " , "No Arrival Delay")
CustomField.label: Arrival Delay Length
